title: Entanglement generation by unequal-dimension Bell-diagonal projections and a no-go theorem for local twirling: an audit and restoration of Phys. Rev. A 109, 012217 (2024)
description:
Manuscript, deterministic verification script and figure script for an audit of Proposition 1 of J. Moerland, N. Wyderka, H. Kampermann and D. Bruß, Phys. Rev. A 109, 012217 (2024). For local dimensions d_A < d_B the proposition states that an average over local unitaries equals the projection onto the generalized Bell basis, so that this projection is a non-entangling channel. Both parts fail.

Main results: (i) the local average is an LOCC channel that is not the Bell projection; the group generated by its Kraus unitaries has order lcm(d_A,d_B) d_B (d_B/gcd)^{d_A}, its fixed-point algebra has dimension gcd(d_A,d_B), and its iterates converge to a dephasing-and-shift twirl; (ii) for all 2 ≤ d_A < d_B the Bell projection maps an explicit pure product state to a state whose partial transpose has the single negative eigenvalue -1/(4 d_A); (iii) the pinching is the unique positive trace-preserving map with basis-diagonal outputs that fixes the basis projectors, so no LOCC, separable, PPT or separability-preserving channel Bell-diagonalizes in unequal dimensions; (iv) the bound entangled states and entanglement witnesses of the audited paper do not depend on Proposition 1 and remain valid.

The script verify_unequal_bell_projection.py reproduces all formulas and numbers (116 checks, the decisive ones in exact rational arithmetic).
